svg.text: ROM: decoder, diode matrix and restore
Word lines are 4-diode ANDs of PC/nPC with 10k pull-ups. Each bit line is a diode-OR of word lines.
Each bit line is restored by two inverters (nX, then X). Pins are named by function; small numbers are TLC556 pins.

g.text: ROM matrix: diode-OR per bit line
Bit lines: 1M pull-down each, then to the restore inverters below.
I0–I3 also take the input-port term CND·nJ·SWi (the IN instruction), drawn on nI0–nI3.
